create_ScaleFactor_module: create a ScaleFactor nn.Module that scales tensor inputs by a learned scalar factor
fit_ScaleFactor_with_context: fit a ScaleFactor module using fit_context_ to compute variance ratio from observed tensors
set_ScaleFactor_value: set the scale_factor parameter on a fitted ScaleFactor module to a specific value
observe_tensor_variances: observe input and reference tensor variances through ScaleFactor forward pass for variance tracking
reset_ScaleFactor: reset a ScaleFactor module by zeroing its scale_factor parameter to unfitted state
